description: TypeScript 7.0.2 is the latest stable release, but typescript-eslint 8.72.1 declares a peer range below 6.1.0. TypeScript 6.0.3 preserves type-aware lint coverage.
risk: TypeScript 7 language and checker improvements are unavailable until upstream peer support lands.
mitigation: Remain on TypeScript 6.0.3 with full type checking and ESLint coverage; review when typescript-eslint widens its peer range.

description: The latest stable deepmerge release remains affected by GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 (prototype poisoning). It is a transitive build/test dependency of @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte.
risk: Low-severity prototype-poisoning risk limited to build/test tooling; it is not shipped in the desktop runtime bundle.
mitigation: Keep the dependency in development scope only, review upstream releases, and replace it when a fixed release is published.

description: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 was resolved by an approved npm override to minimatch 11.0.4. The exception is retained closed for audit history.
risk: Moderate denial-of-service risk in build/test tooling only; not shipped in the desktop runtime bundle.
mitigation: npm overrides pins minimatch 11.0.4 across the frontend toolchain; lint and build tests pass.

description: russh 0.65.1 resolves rsa 0.10.0-rc.18, which is affected by RUSTSEC-2023-0071 (Marvin timing side channel). RustSec reports no fixed upgrade.
risk: Medium-severity timing side channel in RSA signing; only relevant when RSA host/user keys are used.
mitigation: Prefer Ed25519 keys; keep SSH transport verification enabled; track the upstream stable rsa release and replace when available.

description: russh 0.65.1 resolves the pre-release ssh-key 0.7.0-rc.11. No stable russh release provides a compatible stable ssh-key dependency yet.
risk: Pre-release parsing code is used for SSH key handling; covered by the existing SSH, host-key, and security test suites.
mitigation: Keep host-key verification and secret redaction tests enabled; replace when russh ships a stable ssh-key dependency.

description: The zbus 5.15.1 stack used by the Linux Secret Service credential backend is marked unmaintained by RustSec.
risk: Maintenance risk on Linux only; no known vulnerability and no weaker credential path.
mitigation: Track keyring and secret-service releases; replace the backend when a maintained zbus line is adopted.

description: russh 0.65.1 resolves pkcs1 0.8.0-rc.4 through rsa 0.10.0-rc.18. No stable compatible release exists yet.
risk: Pre-release ASN.1/RSA parsing code is used only for RSA key handling; covered by SSH and security tests.
mitigation: Prefer Ed25519 keys; keep protocol/security suites enabled; replace when rsa ships a stable dependency set.
